menstrual.title: Menstrual phase
menstrual.normal: Cramps or tired? Be gentle with yourself, but keep taking good care of your body. Keep warm and rest when needed.
menstrual.nutrition: Iron-rich food, magnesium, and omega-3 support you from the inside out.

menstrual.title: Menstrual phase
menstrual.normal: Your body is working hard behind the scenes. Gentle movement, warmth, and rest are your best friends right now: no obligations, just taking good care of yourself.
menstrual.nutrition: Soups, warm meals, and iron-rich products like spinach or legumes help your body recover.

menstrual.title: Menstrual phase
menstrual.normal: Lower energy is not a failure, it is your body resetting. Listen to what you need and give yourself permission for it.
menstrual.nutrition: Magnesium and omega-3 can help with cramps. Avoid too much caffeine if you are sensitive to it.

follicular.title: Follicular phase
follicular.normal: Your energy is building up again. A phase where you want to move forward and put things in motion.
follicular.nutrition: Carbohydrates give you energy, while proteins contribute to muscle building and recovery.

follicular.title: Follicular phase
follicular.normal: This is a great phase to pick up new things or sharpen habits again. Your head is clear and your recovery is faster.
follicular.nutrition: B-vitamines and zinc support your energy production and recovery: think of eggs, nuts, and whole grains.

follicular.title: Follicular phase
follicular.normal: Your estrogen is rising and you notice it: more motivation, better focus, and a lighter mood. Use this, but also keep space for some rest.
follicular.nutrition: Sufficient proteins and carbohydrates give your body the fuel to build.

ovulatory.title: Ovulatory phase
ovulatory.normal: You are often at your strongest: energetic, clear, and powerful. Trust your body and use this phase in a way that suits you.
ovulatory.nutrition: Light, nutritious meals and antioxidants support your energy and vitality.

ovulatory.title: Ovulatory phase
ovulatory.normal: This is your energy peak. You feel more social, stronger, and more in flow. A good time to tackle things you otherwise dread.
ovulatory.nutrition: Omega-3 fatty acids and antioxidants, such as in fatty fish, berries, and nuts, support you during higher activity.

ovulatory.title: Ovulatory phase
ovulatory.normal: Hormones are peaking now and that gives you a natural advantage. Enjoy it, but don't overdo it: recovery remains important in this phase too.
ovulatory.nutrition: Fiber helps keep your hormones in balance. Think of vegetables, fruits, and legumes.

luteal.title: Luteal phase
luteal.normal: Your body slowly switches to more rest. More appetite, less energy, or retaining some extra water is completely normal in this phase.
luteal.nutrition: Magnesium, complex carbohydrates, calcium, and vitamin B6 support your satiety and energy balance. Think of oatmeal, banana, yogurt, sweet potato, and nuts.

luteal.title: Luteal phase
luteal.normal: This is often a phase where your body needs more stability and recovery. Being a little softer on yourself is allowed right now.
luteal.nutrition: Magnesium, complex carbohydrates, calcium, and vitamin B6 support your satiety and energy balance. For example, choose quinoa, dark chocolate, avocado, spinach, and eggs.

luteal.title: Luteal phase
luteal.normal: Your energy can fluctuate a bit more these days. That is normal and part of the changes taking place in your body.
luteal.nutrition: Magnesium, complex carbohydrates, calcium, and vitamin B6 support your satiety and energy balance. Think of whole wheat pasta, almonds, salmon, pumpkin seeds, and yogurt.
